title: 第19章 青灵宗第20章 包厢之争
lines: 洞外。
燃起一堆篝火。
许辰从储物戒取出乌灵蟒的尸体，切了一块蛇肉，用清水洗净后，穿上树枝，架在篝火上。
脚步声忽然从洞内传来。
随之，香风袭来。
许辰偏过脑袋，看着款款走来的红裙女人。
这个女人似乎独爱红裙。
原本那件红裙已经坏了，在他提议之下，女人也换了件新的，不过，还是红裙。
红裙女人在许辰对面坐下，盯着篝火上已经半熟的蛇肉，微笑道：“你的胆子不小，竟敢偷走乌灵蟒的尸体。”
许辰一阵尴尬。
说起来，乌灵蟒是红裙女人斩杀的，理应是她的战利品，现在面对红裙女人，他有种偷东西被人捉住的窘迫感。
“我那是光明正大的收取。”
许辰狡辩道。
红裙女人笑而不语。
许辰连忙转移话题，“我叫许辰，散修一个，你呢？”
“苏芸。”
红裙女人诧异的看了许辰一眼，旋即含笑说道。
简单的交谈了几句，两人便陷入沉默，两双眼睛盯着篝火上不停翻转的蛇肉。
蛇肉已经烤的两面金黄。
撒上一撮盐巴之后，味道更诱人了。
乌灵蟒的肉本就是顶级的食材之一，简单烧烤，然后撒上一撮盐巴，味道就堪比山珍海味。
令人食指大动的肉香飘荡在空气之中。
苏芸似乎饿了很久，忍不住诱惑，偷偷吞咽了口唾沫。
许辰听力何其敏锐，听到苏芸吞咽口水的声音，转过脑袋，似笑非笑看着她。
苏芸脸颊一红，傲娇的偏过脑袋。
直到许辰把烤好的蛇肉递到她的面前，她才放下矜持，撕下一块蛇肉，放入口中细细咀嚼。
“血护法未死，他从沉睡中醒来，实力虽然没有恢复巅峰，但可以预料，从今以后太商国不会平静了。”
苏芸开始主动找话聊，说到最后，她面色逐渐凝重。
“你以后要小心些，最好加入宗门，寻求庇护。”
许辰点了点头。
“血护法似乎是血神教的护法，血神教很强吗？我怎么从未听说过？”
许辰想到当日黑袍人自称自己是血神教之人，遂借机向苏芸问一问血神教的情况。
苏芸声音低沉，“血神教…一个极其可怕的势力，巅峰之时，它的势力横跨数十个大域，数百小域，有着席卷青洲的趋势，无数势力被灭，亿万生灵惨遭屠戮，终于，六千年前，无数势力联合，历经多年，终于剿灭了血神教。”
许辰心中凛然。
巅峰时的血神教，横跨数十大域，数百小域，势力之大，当真恐怖如斯。
要知道，太商国只是荒域内无数个国家中微不起眼的一个，而荒域只是个小域。
太商国五大宗门，在血神教眼中，恐怕连只蝼蚁都不如。
如此强横的势力，纵使灭亡，残存的余孽，也是不容小觑。
百足之虫死而不僵。
一旦被血神教余孽盯上，那后果真的不堪设想。
苏芸宽慰道：“你也不用担心，六千年前的血神教固然很强，但经过各方势力的不断打压，血神教的势力不断龟缩，到了今天，血神教余孽已经不敢轻易出世，他们龟缩在阴暗之中，不敢对你明目张胆的出手。”
content_en:
outside the cave.
Build a bonfire.
Xu Chen took out the body of the black spirit python from the storage ring, cut a piece of snake meat, washed it with water, put it on a branch, and put it on the bonfire.
The sound of footsteps suddenly came from inside the cave.
Then, the fragrant wind came.
Xu Chen turned his head and looked at the woman in red dress walking towards him.
This woman seems to only love red dresses.
The original red dress was broken. At his suggestion, the woman also changed into a new one, but it was still a red dress.
The woman in the red dress sat down opposite Xu Chen, stared at the half-cooked snake meat on the bonfire, and said with a smile: "You are so courageous, you dare to steal the body of the Black Spirit Python."
Xu Chen felt embarrassed for a while.
Speaking of which, the Wuling Python was killed by the woman in the red dress and should be her trophy. Now facing the woman in the red dress, he felt embarrassed as if he had been caught stealing something.
"My collection was fair and aboveboard."
Xu Chen argued.
The woman in the red dress smiled and said nothing.
Xu Chen quickly changed the subject, "My name is Xu Chen and I am a casual cultivator. What about you?"
"Su Yun."
The woman in the red dress glanced at Xu Chen in surprise, and then said with a smile.
After a few brief exchanges, the two fell into silence, staring at the snake meat that was constantly turning on the bonfire.
The snake meat has been grilled to golden brown on both sides.
After sprinkling a pinch of salt, the taste becomes even more attractive.
Wuling python's meat is one of the top ingredients. Simply grill it and sprinkle it with a pinch of salt, and it tastes like delicacies from the mountains and seas.
The appetizing aroma of meat floats in the air.
Su Yun seemed to have been hungry for a long time. She couldn't resist the temptation and swallowed secretly.
Xu Chen's hearing was so sharp that when he heard Su Yun swallowing, he turned his head and looked at her with a half-smile.
Su Yun's cheeks turned red and she tilted her head arrogantly.
It wasn't until Xu Chen handed the roasted snake meat in front of her that she put down her reserve, tore off a piece of snake meat, put it in her mouth and chewed it carefully.
"The Blood Protector is not dead. He woke up from his deep sleep. Although his strength has not returned to its peak, it can be expected that the Taishang Kingdom will not be peaceful from now on."
Su Yun started to take the initiative to talk, and at the end of the conversation, her face gradually became serious.
"You should be more careful in the future. It is best to join the sect and seek asylum."
"Yeah."
Xu Chen nodded.
"The Blood Protector seems to be the protector of the Blood God Sect. Is the Blood God Sect very strong? Why have I never heard of it?"
Xu Chen thought of the man in black robe who claimed to be a member of the Blood God Sect, so he took the opportunity to ask Su Yun about the situation of the Blood God Sect.
Su Yun's voice was low, "The Blood God Cult... is an extremely terrifying force. At its peak, its power spanned dozens of large domains and hundreds of small domains. It had the tendency to sweep across Qingzhou. Countless forces were destroyed and hundreds of millions of creatures were slaughtered. Finally, six thousand years ago, countless forces united and after many years, the Blood God Cult was finally wiped out."
Xu Chen felt awe-inspiring in his heart.
At its peak, the Blood God Sect spanned dozens of large domains and hundreds of small domains. It was so powerful that it was truly terrifying.
You must know that Taishang Kingdom is just an inconspicuous country among the countless countries in the wilderness, and the wilderness is only a small domain.
In the eyes of the Blood God Sect, the five major sects of the Taishang Kingdom are probably not even as good as ants.
Even if such a powerful force is destroyed, the remaining remnants cannot be underestimated.
The centipede is dead but not stiff.
Once he is targeted by the remnants of the Blood God Sect, the consequences will be truly disastrous.
Su Yun said with relief: "You don't have to worry. The Blood God Sect six thousand years ago was indeed very strong, but after constant suppression by all forces, the Blood God Sect's power has continued to shrink. Today, the remnants of the Blood God Sect no longer dare to be born easily. They huddle in the darkness and do not dare to take action against you openly."
